patch_description:
Add a final high-sharpness contact-polishing phase starting from the best exact configuration found by the continuation restarts. The existing optimization uses finite-temperature smooth extrema, so its final iterates can remain biased away from the true minimum-distance and diameter contacts. This edit uses concentrated soft contact weights but accepts a proposed move only when the evaluator’s exact squared ratio improves.

The current accepted configuration is retained on every rejected proposal, which is an explicit rollback to the last exact-best state. Momentum and step size are strongly damped after rejection, preventing repeated deterioration from spending the remaining budget outside the best contact basin. This provides a monotone final refinement without risking regression of the incumbent.
